title: Star chart UI (DOM): systems, travel times, occupancy
description: The in-game star chart: a DOM/SVG map of the galaxy (3 seeded systems in v1) showing system names, distances, estimated warp times, and live occupancy badges. This is the navigation surface for inter-system travel.
acceptanceCriteria: Openable from the game HUD (M key or 'Systems' menu button); renders an SVG map with one node per system from the TASK-3 star generator (name, star class color) and edges labeled with light-second distances + warp time (from TASK-4 travel table)
Occupancy: nodes with active shards show a player-count badge (data from GET /api/galaxy/health, polled every 5 s while the chart is open)
Current system node is highlighted; clicking another node selects it and enables a 'Warp' button showing the estimated travel time
Warp click delegates to the warp flow (TASK-8); the chart stays open and shows a 'Warping...' state on the source node during the transition
Chart is deterministic: same GALAXY_SEED always renders the same layout (screenshot test against a committed baseline with pixel-tolerance diff, or an SVG-structure snapshot test)
Keyboard accessible: Tab reaches system nodes, Enter selects, Enter on 'Warp' triggers; focus visible (TASK-54 builds on this)
Unit tests: travel-time label math, occupancy badge rendering, selection state; e2e smoke: open chart in Playwright, screenshot (via TASK-70 harness)

steps.details: src/client/ui/StarChart.tsx: fetch galaxy overview (new tiny endpoint GET /api/galaxy/overview returning [{systemId, name, starClass, pos2D (from seed), neighbors: [{to, distance, warpTime}]}] — add the endpoint in this task, derived from shared generators). Layout: seeded 2D projection (x, y from the star's 3D position projected onto the galactic plane, scaled to a 800x500 viewBox).
Node select (click/Enter), Warp button enable, 'Warping...' state (subscribes to the warp state from TASK-8 — for now a stub event 'warp-started'). Escape closes the chart.
useEffect interval 5 s while open; badge = players count; hide badge when 0. Stop polling on close.
Unit tests per acceptance; Playwright: open chart, verify nodes render, screenshot. Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: GET /api/galaxy/overview is new in this task — it is cheap (seeded derivation, no DB) and cached in-process forever (seed never changes at runtime).
Keep the chart pure DOM/SVG — no WebGL in this panel (a11y + simplicity).
warp-started/warp-complete events are defined in src/client/state/warp.ts now so TASK-8 only implements the flow.
